t: A software-defined radio card that slots into a computer's M.2 slot.
steps: Buy the card from Crowd Supply. Pick the GNSS version for a built-in location receiver.
Find a Linux computer with a free M.2 B or M key slot and room above it.
Get antennas and tiny MHF4 cables for the radio ports.
Install the LimeSuiteNG driver from its limesdr-micro branch.
Install SoapySDR and a listening app such as Gqrx.
Tune to a local FM station as your first test.
Try a simple GNU Radio flow next.
Check your local rules before you transmit anything.
meta: Open Board. From $249. A few stores.
